description: Blob health under violent deformation, scene (b): reuses the A4 melt setup (same geometry, thermal material, and hot floor; see a4_meltfront_v1) but with gravity ON so the melt actually flows, and grades covariance health instead of the melt front. Molten flow is the harshest covariance workout available in this suite: large rotations, extreme stretches, topology-adjacent motion. Systems without thermal support submit nothing and are marked NA. Requires covariances.parquet at full output_fps coverage.

pass_criteria.reference: eigenvalues stay bounded away from degeneracy

regime_assumptions: capability test, N/A allowed for systems without thermal support
provenance.notes: The melt front itself is graded by a4_meltfront_v1; this scene only watches the Gaussians.
